description: The file bytes are not valid UTF-8.
The file starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark (EF BB BF).
The bytes do not form exactly one syntactically valid JSON value (RFC 8259) at the start of the file.
The top-level JSON value is not followed by any byte: the single terminating LF (0x0A) is missing.
The top-level JSON value is followed by something other than exactly one LF (e.g. a second LF, CRLF, a space, or other data).
Insignificant whitespace (space, tab, CR, LF) occurs outside string literals before or inside the top-level value.
An object at any depth contains the same member name more than once (compared after unescaping).
The top-level 'invariant' member is absent.
A top-level member other than 'invariant' (intent, event, observe, meta) is absent.
The top-level object contains a member not in {intent, event, observe, meta, invariant}.
The top-level members are exactly the required set but not in the order intent, event, observe, meta, invariant.
The record violates the F.1 structural schema (schemas/canonical-record.schema.json) in any way not covered by the codes above, including a top-level value that is not an object.
The '<name>.json.sha256' sidecar does not exist.
The sidecar is not exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters followed by one LF (65 bytes).
The sidecar digest differs from the SHA-256 of the record file bytes.
The first differing top-level section versus the reference is 'intent'.
The first differing top-level section versus the reference is 'event'.
The first differing top-level section versus the reference is 'observe'.
The first differing top-level section versus the reference is 'meta'.
The first differing section is 'invariant' and the JSON type of its value changed (object, array, string, number, boolean, null).
The first differing section is 'invariant', its JSON type is unchanged, and it differs other than only by numeric lexical form.
The first differing section differs only in the lexical form of one or more numbers whose numeric values are equal (e.g. 1 vs 1.0 vs 1e0).
Reserved for a future record format carrying version fields. Not emitted in v0.1.
